Integrations/Productivity

Ironclad

Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform for launching and tracking contract workflows, approvals and signatures, and for managing the repository of contract records, entities and obligations.

80 actionsSign in with Ironclad

Connect Ironclad

  • Download Data ExportDownload the file of a finished data export job.
  • Download Record AttachmentDownload one file attached to a record by its attachment key.
  • Download Workflow DocumentDownload one document of a workflow by its document key.
  • Download Workflow Email AttachmentDownload one file attached to an email thread of a workflow.
  • Export Records XLSXDownload an XLSX spreadsheet of records for the record types and property columns you name.

  • Get ObligationGet one obligation by id or Ironclad id.

Takes action

  • Activate RecordActivate a record and set its effective date, term, termination notice, expiration, and renewal behavior.
  • Cancel Record Auto-RenewalCancel auto-renewal for a record.
  • Cancel WorkflowCancel a workflow, recording a comment that explains why.
  • Cancel Workflow Signature RequestCancel the signature request (the signature packet sent to the signers) that is out for signature on a workflow, with a reason.
  • Create Data ExportStart a data export job for workflow activity or the audit log, optionally limited to a date range.
  • Create Embedded Workflow Signature Recipient URLCreate a signing link for one signer that is allowed to load inside a frame on the given parent site.
  • Create EntityCreate an entity (a counterparty or other party that contracts refer to) with a name and, optionally, a relationship type, status, parent…
  • Create ObligationCreate a standalone obligation on a contract record.
  • Create Obligation OccurrenceRecord a new triggered occurrence of an existing source obligation.
  • Create RecordCreate a contract record in the repository with a record type, a name and metadata properties.

  • Create Smart Import RecordUpload a contract file and use Smart Import to create a record and predict its properties.
  • Create Workflow CommentPost a comment to a workflow's activity feed as the connected user, optionally as a reply to another comment and with @-mentions.
  • Create Workflow Signature Recipient URLCreate a link that a signer, or a view-only recipient, can open to reach the workflow's signature request.
  • Delete EntityDelete an entity.
  • Delete ObligationDelete an obligation.
  • Delete RecordDelete a contract record from the repository.
  • Delete Record AttachmentRemove one file from a contract record by its attachment key.

  • Delete Workflow SignerRemove a signer from a workflow's signature packet.
  • Edit Record RenewalEdit a record's renewal type, term, opt-out timing, remaining renewal count, initial term, and expiration settings.
  • Export DataCreate an Ironclad workflow-activity or audit-log data export job, poll its status with a bounded configurable wait, then download and…
  • Extend RecordExtend a record, optionally setting the renewal term length.
  • Launch WorkflowLaunch a workflow from a template.
  • Launch Workflow From Attribute SourceLaunch from an existing Coupa or Salesforce workflow sync mapping.
  • Pause WorkflowPause an active workflow that is in the Review step, recording a comment that explains why.
  • Refresh Workflow From Attribute SourceOnly for an existing attribute source configuration, such as a Coupa or Salesforce workflow sync mapping.
  • Remind Workflow SignerEmail a signer a reminder that their signature is needed.
  • Replace RecordReplace a record with a new type, name and complete set of properties.
  • Resume WorkflowResume a workflow that was paused with IRONCLAD_PAUSE_WORKFLOW, recording a comment.
  • Revert Workflow To ReviewMove a workflow from the Sign step back to the Review step.
  • Schedule Workflow Signature RequestSchedule a workflow's signature request (the signature packet sent to the signers) to go out at a set time, optionally with a reminder…
  • Send Workflow Signature RequestSend a workflow's signature request (the signature packet sent to the signers) out for signature now.
  • Supersede RecordMark a record as superseded on specified recorded and effective dates, optionally linking its replacement record.
  • Terminate RecordTerminate a record on specified recorded and effective dates, optionally linking the record that caused termination.
  • Undo Record Lifecycle ActionReverse a specified lifecycle action previously applied to a record.
  • Update EntityChange selected parts of an entity.
  • Update ObligationChange an obligation's name, type or properties.
  • Update RecordChange selected parts of a record and leave the rest as it is.
  • Update Scheduled Workflow Signature RequestChange the send time or the reminder of the signature request already scheduled on a workflow with…
  • Update Workflow ApprovalApprove a workflow on behalf of one approver role, or set that approval back to pending, as the user the connection acts as.
  • Update Workflow AttributesSet or clear attribute (form field) values on a workflow that is in the Review step, and return the updated workflow.
  • Update Workflow Role AssignmentAssign a workflow role such as Archiver or Signature Coordinator to a different user.
  • Update Workflow Signature PacketReplace the ordered list of documents in a workflow's signature packet, the documents a signature request sends to the signers.
  • Update Workflow SignerReassign a signer role of a workflow to another signer, or change an external signer's name or email.
  • Upload Record AttachmentAttach a file to a contract record under an attachment key.
  • Upload Signed Workflow DocumentUpload a signed PDF to a workflow that is in the Sign step.
